# Chinese Tea Guide

Your practical guide to Chinese tea — types, famous teas, brewing methods, tea culture, and how to choose the right tea.

## Site Structure

- Homepage: https://chinese-tea.com
  - Tea Types (six major categories)
  - Famous Teas (16 iconic Chinese teas with brewing and buying guides)
  - Brewing Guide (gongfu and western methods, water guide, cold brew)
  - Tea Regions (Zhejiang, Fujian, Yunnan, Anhui, Jiangsu, Guangdong)
  - Tea Culture and Ceremony
  - Health Benefits
  - Food Pairing
  - Teaware Essentials
  - Buying and Storage Guide
  - FAQ (13 common questions)

## About

This site is built to help English-speaking tea lovers discover the world of Chinese tea through practical, experience-based information — exact brewing temperatures, realistic price ranges, quality checks, and common scams to avoid.
